push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 9.2 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, if I could bottle that 9.2, I'd sell it at every gas station from here to Wichita.

THE GOOD
+ A brace against JamRock  United, your 2nd straight match scoring. Cool head, quick feet, ball in the onion bag.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. You were the best player on the pitch, and you know it. Now stay humble.
+ A new personal record at 9.2. That's growth you can hold.
+ Fewest misplaced passes on the team (4). That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ Team-high 2 tackles won. Bottle that and bring it next match.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Real talk: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized. You've got this.
- BellyTb1 and you both slipped on defensive work rate. Catch each other: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was BellyTb1's 2). That's not a crisis, but it's a warning light.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 23 (best was PhogsToffees's 27). Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.
- 2 goals conceded: -0.1. Next rep, better rep.

Training-ground special: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

Hey, buddskees. Kindness costs nothing and wins locker rooms.

I'm proud as a peacock. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 8.8 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, that 8.8 was a big ol' slice of good football.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). That pass had more vision than a lighthouse.
+ A goal against JamRock  United. Ball in the net, smile on my face. That's the deal.
+ You and buddskees were finishing each other's sentences out there.
+ That 8.8 sits as your 5th best match performance of the season. Lovely stuff.
+ Their humans averaged 7.1 to our 8.3; we out-played them man for man. That's what happens when we pull the same rope.

THE BAD
- Shot accuracy 25%, down from your usual 89%. Let's not make that a pattern.
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Write this down: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball. Clean it up and fly.
- 71% passing (17 of 24, down from your usual 79%). Here's the deal: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it. Easy as pie.
- You and buddskees need to sync up on defensive work rate: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 2 goals conceded took 0.1 away. Fixable.

Practice pointer: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Nobody remembers the miss. Everybody remembers the response.

That's the player I knew you were. - Coach Lasso
